description: Start AudioDN account login (OAuth). Call this when the user wants to upload tracks, manage collections, embed a player, or otherwise use live API tools and is not signed in yet. On the hosted MCP URL this triggers the client OAuth flow (sign up or log in, create org, pick output presets, default collection, optional trial). After sign-in, retry the live tool.

reason.description: Short reason shown in logs (e.g. "upload a track", "embed player").

name: adn_sign_in
